content: (3.6-4.3)发饰跟随曲线头发v1.0 提取码: qsmv
！你好？
Oh, so you're actually a human. Thought the platform had a memory leak or something.
我当然是人类，这都什么问题…你是人机？
Nah. Pretty rude assumption, honestly. I'm legally flesh and bone.
明明是你先怀疑我是人机的！好吧，这其实很诡异，我通常和陌生人的打招呼方式不是人机认证。
Same here, lol. But when a bunch of foreign symbols, random test strings, and file links suddenly invade an empty ID, it's either an automated script or advanced scamming.
…你在开玩笑，对吧（？
Obviously. Though... why is there an open parenthesis before the question mark? Is that a syntactic typo or a mood marker(?
这个…！你有没有觉得在问号前加一个括号会增加疑惑的感觉，有点像很疑惑但弱弱不敢问（）
Fascinating. Pragmatic hedging encoded directly into punctuation.
May—be(?
取笑得很好，下次不要再取笑了
Don't misunderstand, I'm sincerely praising you 😐
好的，你的诚意我心领了，你的赞扬，就让它随风而去吧
Is my praise so light that it can be blown away by a gust of wind?
哈哈哈，没那么重
'Not that heavy?' The sarcasm is leaking through the screen.
我才没有挖苦呢，这是中文里的一种流行表达
Okay, another strange rule from a foreigner 👆
嘿！我有名字的
I have one too, what are you showing off for?
你知道我在说什么。。
Fine, what's your name?
不告诉你哈哈哈
Oh, secret human. May I call you Miss Secret, or Mr. Secret?
沃尔玛塑料袋
…Seriously? Well, didn't expect that gender identity to exist over there.
开玩笑的啦，但还是不要叫我秘密小姐，这听起来很肉麻（！）你可以叫我Sarah
Sarah? I thought you'd give me some Chinese characters. Is this your real name?
如果不是，我会被当成诈骗吗？
Yep
我才不信呢
I don't know, Miss Liar. Anyway, I use my real name here.
? 你叫 @/ 没有哪个国家会有人叫这个吧
Oh, you'd be surprised. I come from a remote and barbaric tribe where we communicate in sacred glyphs. '@/' literally translates to 'the boundless ocean'.
…让我查查什么名字代表了海洋
Smart move. But I highly doubt your search engine's linguistic competence.
首先我猜你不叫 Ocean，这太明显了，或许你叫 Mogen？
Uh, I assume you mean 'Morgan'?
…不要在意这些细节啦
Nope. Nice try, though.
真的不能直接告诉我吗，Marina?
Still no... and for the record, I'm strictly a guy, even if my name can be unisex around here.
哦。。好的 Mr. Kai，我猜你来自欧洲
THIS SO SOON?
我问了 ai 呀
Aha! Another day of human defeat.
人类一败涂地——二拜高堂——夫妻对拜——
...I think my translator just had a stroke :(
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
Not funny. It literally said something about bowing to parents and getting married???

Actually, it's a Chinese homophone joke. Defeat（败） and bow（拜） have the same pronunciation in Chinese, and in traditional Chinese weddings, there is a ceremony called "Bài Táng", where the newlyweds have to bow three times, namely, bow to heaven and earth, bow to their parents, and bow to each other as husband and wife. The phrases "bow to heaven and earth" and "a complete defeat" sound very similar.
That's a lot of English. I thought you only spoke Chinese.
嘿！我只是不擅长，毕竟不是我的母语
Ve skutečnosti to taky není můj mateřský jazyk, ale zjistil jsem, že mluvit anglicky mě činí mezinárodním.
我觉得你的母语更国际化一些…
Aha? Tak já budu mluvit mateřštinou?
别呀，你说母语我就彻底离不开翻译器了——
To je skvělý, aspoň nech svůj překladač trochu makat!
